ModBlobMote.name: Mote Blob
ModBlobMote.attack: Quick lunging nip, very short range
passive: The Gleaner's own blob, earned by its challenge.
They spawn in pairs

ModBlobSpitter.name: Spitter Blob
ModBlobSpitter.attack: Spit goo along the floor; leaves a slowing puddle
passive: The Poltergeist's own blob, earned by its challenge

ModBlobGel.name: Gel Blob
passive: The Binder's own blob, earned by its challenge.
The ghost button fuses Gels into bigger blobs

ModBlobBrute.name: Brute Blob
ModBlobBrute.special: Ghost button: Bounce, hop and land in a ring
passive: Fused from two Gels. It never fuses again
Back leaves it. Left alone, it uses its special

ModBlobTitan.name: Titan Blob
ModBlobTitan.special: Ghost button: Engulf, lunge and swallow
passive: Fused from three Gels. Leaves a Gel when it dies
Back leaves it. Left alone, it uses its special

ModBlobKing.name: King Blob
ModBlobKing.attack: Heavy slam that sends a ring of goo out ahead
ModBlobKing.special: Ghost button: Rain, globs fall on shadows
passive: Silver and gold ghosts only. Costs more ectoplasm
Back leaves it. Left alone, it uses its special

ModGhostGleaner.name: Gleaner
ModGhostGleaner.attack: Take over the body you float over
ModGhostGleaner.special: Spawn a blob, or a pair of Motes once earned
passive: Ectoplasm drifts to you, and extra wisps appear.
Each pickup is worth less than a normal one

ModGhostBinder.name: Binder
ModGhostBinder.attack: Take over the body you float over
ModGhostBinder.special: Spawn a blob, or a Gel once earned
passive: Earned Gels fuse with the ghost button:
two make a Brute, three a Titan, close to you

ModGhostPoltergeist.name: Poltergeist
ModGhostPoltergeist.special: Spawn a blob, or a Spitter once earned
passive: On top of a body, Attack takes it over instead

ModGhostBanshee.name: Banshee
ModGhostBanshee.attack: Wail (costs ectoplasm): slows a hero close by
passive: On top of a body, Attack takes it over instead

ModGhostSexton.name: Sexton
ModGhostSexton.attack: Take over the body you float over
ModGhostSexton.special: Dig a grave (one body), up to three at once
passive: A Revenant claws out when the hero comes near,
or after a while

ModGhostKindler.name: Kindler
ModGhostKindler.attack: Light the sparking Fusebelly from afar
passive: On top of a body, Attack takes it over instead.
Light your nearest Fusebelly from afar

ModGhostMason.name: Mason
ModGhostMason.attack: Every Gargling you own spits a stone
ModGhostMason.special: Spawn a Gargling, a stone turret
passive: On top of a body, Attack takes it over instead

ModGhostHexer.name: Hexer
ModGhostHexer.attack: Throw a pin: the hero is hexed for a while
passive: Hexed heroes take more damage.
On top of a body, Attack takes it over instead

ModGhostMiser.name: Miser
ModGhostMiser.attack: Take over the body you float over
ModGhostMiser.special: Spend every stored body on one Mimic
passive: The Mimic has that many times the health.
Coins circle you while you hold two or more

ModGhostSilver.name: Silver Shade
ModGhostSilver.attack: Take over the body you float over
passive: Touch the silver orbs your monsters drop.
With eight, your next body goes up a tier

ModGhostGold.name: Gold Spectre
ModGhostGold.attack: Take over the body you float over
passive: As a monster, press the ghost button
to jump out. The body fights on for you

ModFodKeener.name: Keener
ModFodKeener.attack: Shriek a short sound wave that can slow the hero
passive: A Banshee ghost's follower: quick and fragile
ModFodKeener.vault: A Banshee's wailing head. Its shriek can slow the hero

ModFodRevenant.name: Revenant
passive: A Sexton ghost's follower. It claws out of a grave
when the hero comes near
ModFodRevenant.vault: A Sexton's grave ghoul. It claws out of the earth when the hero passes

ModFodFusebelly.name: Fusebelly
ModFodFusebelly.attack: Lick the hero with your burning fuse
ModFodFusebelly.special: Blow: swell up and burst in a big blast (you die)
passive: A Kindler ghost's follower. It pops when it dies.
The Kindler's Attack can light it from afar
ModFodFusebelly.vault: A Kindler's tallow bomb on legs. It always goes off in the end

ModFodGargling.name: Gargling
ModFodGargling.attack: Spit a stone at the hero
ModFodGargling.special: Fan: spit three stones in a spread
passive: A Mason ghost's follower: tough but barely moves.
The Mason's Attack makes every Gargling spit
ModFodGargling.vault: A Mason's stone sentry. It holds its post and spits stones

ModFodPoppet.name: Poppet
ModFodPoppet.attack: Jab a pin; it can hex the hero
passive: A Hexer ghost's follower. Hexed heroes take
more damage
ModFodPoppet.vault: A Hexer's voodoo doll. Its pin leaves the hero hexed

ModFodMimic.name: Mimic
ModFodMimic.attack: Chomp the hero with your lid
ModFodMimic.special: Spit: a spray of three coins
passive: A Miser ghost's follower. It has the health of
every body the Miser spent on it
ModFodMimic.vault: A Miser's hoard with teeth. Stronger for every body spent on it
